servinfo.title: Exhaust System Description
servinfo.ptxt: The exhaust system consists of an exhaust manifold incorporated in the cylinder head, a Three-Way Catalytic converter (TWC), Gasoline Particulate Filter (GPF), exhaust pipes, a muffler and seals, gasket, and so on.
The TWC is emission control device to lower the levels of Hydrocarbon (HC), Carbon Monoxide (CO) and Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) pollutants and, GPF purifies the exhaust gas furthermore.
